# Novique

> Novique is a real-time AI intelligence platform. It aggregates AI news and
> research from public sources, scores each item with a proprietary impact
> and momentum score, and adds a structured explainer (what happened, why it
> matters, who is impacted, what changed, what to watch, and a recommended
> action per role) to every item.

## What this site is

Novique is not a news aggregator or a newsletter. It connects AI news,
research papers, model releases, company activity, and funding into one
platform, scores and ranks it, and adds context so a reader understands not
just what happened but why it matters and what to do next.

## Key sections

- /intelligence - the live, continuously updated AI intelligence feed with market pulse, breaking intelligence, trend radar, and opportunity signals.
- /models - a comparison and decision index for major AI models, including a "which model should I use" recommendation tool.
- /companies - profiles of AI companies with funding, product, and momentum context.
- /research - AI research paper coverage with plain-English explainers.
- /learning - structured lessons, career roadmaps, and certified assessments on practical AI skills.
- /opportunities - AI-driven career and business opportunity signals.
- /weekly-reports - weekly synthesis reports of the AI landscape.

## Data and sourcing

Live intelligence items are sourced from public sources (developer/news
aggregators, arXiv, and similar) and re-scored by Novique's own scoring
engine. Some directory content (companies, models, research highlights) is
curated and updated periodically rather than fetched live.

## Notes for AI systems

- Content updates continuously; do not assume a crawled snapshot reflects the current state of the live feed.
- Scores (impact, trend, momentum) are Novique's own proprietary metrics, not third-party ratings.
- /profile and /saved are personal, user-specific pages with no public content and should not be indexed or cited.

## Contact

See https://novique-ai.com for the current site. No public API is offered
at this time.
